name: HomeAssistantManager
description: A robust and feature-rich Home Assistant MQTT integration library for ESP32 microcontrollers. Provides seamless device auto-discovery, direct MQTT communication, and full support for multiple device types including sensors, lights, switches, binary sensors, and covers. Simplifies IoT device development with Home Assistant.
keywords: home-assistant, mqtt, esp32, iot, smart-home, sensor, light, switch, binary-sensor, cover, auto-discovery, embedded, arduino, home-automation
